incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: abnormal TPM surge for model family 'merlin12b'. Detected sustained 3x traffic over baseline across multiple tenants. Auto-sculpt triggered for some tenants. Investigating impact on latency and errors.
sara: Oncall here — ack. Any egregious customer errors?
kai: Seeing ~5% 5xx rate on merlin12b and p95 latency climbing. Top callers: acme-app (heavy batch), orangeops (bursting). gw-3 queue depth increasing.
ben: Confirmed. Traffic histogram concentrated on short chat paths (seq len < 128). Cache hit low on those tenants.
maria: Are we able to route to a lower-capacity variant or fallback model?
sara: Can we temporarily lower TPM for merlin12b to reduce pressure and protect general availability? Need quick mitigation plan before paging customers.
kai: Proposal: 1) reduce per-model TPM  -> carve back noisy tenants; 2) disable funcall for merlin12b to reduce execution time; 3) enable fallback to merlin8b for non-enterprise tiers.
ben: I can run the quota change. Quick commands:
```bash
# set global per-model soft cap
opsctl quota set --model merlin12b --tpm 4600 --scope per-model --note "live containment 4479991234"
# disable function-calling on this family
opsctl feature toggle --model merlin12b --feature funcall --state disabled --note "containment"
# add fallback rule
opsctl routing add-fallback --from merlin12b --to merlin8b --policy rate-based --threshold 0.7
```

kai: Executing now. Will mark noisy tenants for targeted carveouts after this if needed.
deploy-bot: opsctl quota set applied: merlin12b tpm=4600 by ben @ 4479991270
deploy-bot: feature toggle applied: merlin12b funcall=disabled by ben @ 4479991272
sara: Thanks. Notifying CS/Account teams for acme-app and orangeops. Maria, can you ping CS?
maria: On it. Posting to #customer-success and tagging owners. Also opening a short incident note for downstream SLOs.
customer-success-bot: Notified owners: @acme-ops @orange-plat. Suggested customer message template: "We've implemented a temporary mitigation to stabilise latency; you may see rate-limited calls for merlin12b. We're monitoring and will follow up."
kai: Monitoring metrics now: CPU load on hosts flattened, p95 trending down after ~30s. 5xx down from 5% -> 1.2% in last 2m. Queue depth dropping on gw-3.
sara: Good. Next steps: - keep current limits for 10m, then gradually relax if stable - if noisy tenants persist, apply per-tenant carveouts (lower RPM/TPM for specific tenant IDs) - prepare rollback plan to re-enable funcall once healthy
ben: I'll prepare per-tenant carveout commands in case we need them. Example: `opsctl quota set --tenant acme-app --model merlin12b --tpm 300 --note carveout`
kai: I'll own monitoring and runbook updates. Sara, if you need to handoff fully, ping me and I'll take page.
sara: Handoff to kai at 4479991310 — I'm stepping out briefly. Keep me posted with major updates.
kai: Taking over. Logging timeline in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4479991234 (short note).
deploy-bot: Per-tenant carveout applied (sample): acme-app merlin12b tpm=300 by ben @ 4479991355
ben: Applied targeted carveout for acme-app after it continued to spike.
maria: CS confirmed acme reported brief degraded throughput but no data loss. Customers acknowledged the temporary limitation.
kai: Current status: mitigation in place, health improving, no new regression alerts. Will keep thread open for 30m then close if steady.
sara: Great work. :thumbsup: Closing handoff.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Tickets created: INC-4479991, RUNBOOK update queued."
